SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__clinicS: Finding a shadow clinic: a contact's Etiquette (Street) vs 12/15 (corps 11/17) or a search, SSC p. 99 (book) or no clinic step (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__surgeon: Surgeon's fee: 1,000 / 5,000 / 25,000 / 250,000¥ by the operation's size, Cybertechnology p. 54 (book) or no fee (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__gradedF: Graded clinic fees: the surgeon's fee and the care × 50 for alpha and beta, × 200 for delta, Cybertechnology p. 44 (book) or standard rates (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__feeAlph: Graded clinic fees: the multiplier for alpha and beta ware (Cybertechnology p. 44: 50)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__feeDelt: Graded clinic fees: the multiplier for delta ware (Cybertechnology p. 44: 200)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__removal: Removing cyberware: the lower of Biotech and Cybernetics vs 10 − Essence; no successes loses 10% more, Shadowtech (book) or no test (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__damageL: Ware damage levels: Light half bonuses, Moderate stops, Serious +1 and Deadly +2 TN on every test, Shadowtech (book) or damaged / not damaged (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.CLINIC_V99__repair: Cyberware repair by damage level: TN 2/3/4/8 (× 2 alpha, × 3 beta), 2 × Essence hours × level, Shadowtech (book) or the repair table (v980)
SR2E.Tools.clinic99.label: Clinics and ware damage (book)
SR2E.Tools.clinic99.hint: Find a shadow clinic through a contact, remove cyberware with the removal test, set or clear a ware's damage level.
SR2E.Clinic99.Tool.title: Clinics and ware damage (book)
SR2E.Clinic99.Tool.intro: Rolled on your client: the contact's test, the removal test. The records are yours (world settings).
SR2E.Clinic99.allOff: The clinic and ware damage rules are all switched off (house rules).
SR2E.Clinic99.gmOnlyButton: Only a GM can use this button.
SR2E.Clinic99.gmCardOnly: This card names no cyberware the GM can find.
SR2E.Clinic99.notTheirs: The card's author doesn't own that ware's character.
SR2E.Clinic99.nothingRecorded: The damage record has nothing for that ware (already cleared).
SR2E.Clinic99.noPeople: There are no characters or NPCs in the world.
SR2E.Clinic99.Why.off: That rule is switched off (house rules).
SR2E.Clinic99.Why.delta: A delta clinic has no test: the corp has to want the character there.
SR2E.Clinic99.Why.noDice: The contact has no dice for this test.
SR2E.Clinic99.Why.destroyed: Destroyed ware can't be repaired, only replaced.
